FEAT-1-STORY-19.title: Provider Search FastAPI Endpoint Exposure
FEAT-1-STORY-19.description: Expose provider search capability via FastAPI endpoint in main.py, wiring request handling to tool router and ensuring proper request/response serialization and error handling.

FEAT-1-STORY-20.title: Location Filtering and FIPS/County Resolution Integration
FEAT-1-STORY-20.description: Integrate FIPS-to-county mapping and multi-stage location filtering (state, city, county) within provider search flow to ensure accurate geographic scoping of results.

FEAT-1-STORY-21.title: Embedding and Query Expansion Integration
FEAT-1-STORY-21.description: Integrate embedding client and AI-driven query expansion into provider search flow to enhance vector search recall and improve matching quality before taxonomy fallback.

FEAT-1-STORY-22.title: Search Result Formatting and Ranking Output Contract
FEAT-1-STORY-22.description: Standardize provider search output formatting including ranking scores, specialty attribution, and metadata to ensure consistent downstream consumption by chat UI.

FEAT-1-STORY-23.title: End-to-End Tool-Driven Provider Search Integration Test (LLM Loop)
FEAT-1-STORY-23.description: Validate full provider search execution through LLM tool-use loop including tool invocation, facade orchestration, service execution, and response rendering in chat context.
